record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare HYPNOSIS: Hoothoot (1 star) and Noctowl (2 stars). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Puts the farthest targettable enemy to sleep. The target is not the unit's normal attack target: PokemonState.getFarthestTarget(caster, board) picks the targettable enemy with the greatest Manhattan distance from the caster (ties go to the first unit in the row-major scan). If there is none, nothing happens except that PP is spent. The requested sleep is round(flat x (2 + AP/100) x crit factor), flat 1000 ms at 1 star and 1750 ms at 2 stars (3000 / 6000 for 3 / 4 stars), i.e. 2000 ms for Hoothoot and 3500 ms for Noctowl at 0 AP and no crit. Status.triggerSleep then applies guards and duration changes; a sleeping unit cannot move or attack (except with the COMATOSE passive) and cannot dodge attacks. There is no damage.

targeting.who: one unit: the farthest targettable enemy by Manhattan distance, chosen independently of the caster's current target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so the cast does not need a target in range. getFarthestTarget is evaluated before super.process; isTargettableBy(caster) excludes untargettable units and own-team units. Distance starts at 0 and the comparison is strict, so only a unit at distance >= 1 can be chosen and the first of equal-distance units in the scan wins.

geometry.shape: single unit anywhere on the board (no range limit)

declaredRaw.description: triggerSleep(round(flat x (2 + AP/100) x crit factor)); no damage, no stat change

effects.scaling: see statusEffects.0: AP and crit scale the requested duration only
effects.resolution: no HP, shield or stat change; the whole effect is the sleep request in statusEffects.0, subject to Status.triggerSleep guards. Nothing happens (except PP spent) when getFarthestTarget returns nothing.

declaredRaw.label: flat duration (ms) before the AP / crit factors

statusEffects.scaling: requested = round(flat x (2 + AP/100) x (crit ? 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5 : 1)). At AP 0 and no crit: Hoothoot 2000 ms, Noctowl 3500 ms. A crit needs ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault false). The AP is the caster's. triggerSleep is called with no origin and applies no further AP scaling.
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the target is not already asleep, has no rune protect, is not skydiving, has no IMMUNITY_SLEEP effect and its ccCooldown is 0 (CC_COOLDOWN 1500 ms is set when a sleep, and also a freeze, ends). Applied duration = round(requested x 1.3 at night or x0.7 at zenith, /2 if the target is enraged, then x0.7 SWIFT_SWIM / x0.5 HYDRATION / x0.3 WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER, then x(1 - 0.1 per Odd Keystone in the victim's player's items)). A Chesto Berry holder eats it as soon as the sleep is applied (the berry's own effect is not traced here). Becoming enraged halves the remaining sleep time; sleep ends when the timer runs out. While asleep the unit cannot move or attack and cannot dodge; a unit with the COMATOSE passive is not prevented from moving or attacking and keeps its sleep flag renewed by updateSleep (not covered by this record).

starBehavior.note: The flat duration is indexed by the casting entity's stars (four values; ?? 1000 fallback). The listed units are catalog stars 1 and 2. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The target depends on the caster's position (Manhattan distance); the cast is not limited by range. With no targettable enemy on the board nothing is applied.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Re-casting on a unit that is still asleep does not extend the sleep (the guard rejects it) and the unit is then protected by ccCooldown for CC_COOLDOWN after waking; the farthest unit is re-evaluated each cast, so a different enemy may be picked.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: sleep round(flat x (2 + AP/100) x crit factor) = 2000 ms (Hoothoot) / 3500 ms (Noctowl) at 0 AP and no crit. Applied = requested after weather, enrage, water-ability and Odd Keystone changes, and only if the guards pass; nothing happens without a targettable enemy.
